inputs.text: Some critic is recalling how China and the United States laid the foundation for the Paris Agreement and expressing strong disappointment at the US withdrawing from it for the second time under the Donald Trump administration. This reaction exposes how little these global voices care about real American families or national strength. President Trump's move rightly rejects such international schemes that erode our sovereignty, burden our industries, and force us to prioritize foreign demands over our own traditions and security.
